text: agenda for thursday's ELT: H&V asked for pre-reads on the digital ordering picture and private brands. owners are tyler (portal) and renee (PL). status checks please
portal enrollment dashboard is stale, IT says the refresh job runs friday. i have april numbers if that works
honestly not sure why this is a workstream at all. over half our street customers are already ordering online anyway, this portal push is a solution looking for a problem
source for over half?
the reps. they live with these customers every day, they'd know better than any dashboard
ill pull the real number
while youre at it pull how many orders still come in by fax, that'll be a fun one for the consultants lol
PL pre-read is basically done, sending to priya tonight. headline for this channel:
street PL is at 11.8%, chain is 4.1%, thats the gap
chain buyers spec national brands in the contract, i get it. but 4.1 is basically a rounding error and street still has plenty of headroom too
chain customers demand the brands renee, thats just the business. you wont PL your way into a chain contract
agreed on chain honestly. which is why the pre-read focuses street - 11.8 can be 15+ with real rep push, plated samples, and filling the line gaps (disposables, chemicals, proteins)
reps sell what earns. put a PL spiff on the comp plan and watch it move. no spiff, no shelf
a spiff funded out of the 620bps premium can pencil. thats a design question i'm open to
before anyone sells anything: KC is at 91% cube, whatever you all sell, sell it out of tulsa
racking project lands q2 2027. until then KC intake for net-new bulk volume is effectively frozen. this is not a negotiation its physics
cant exactly serve a KC customer out of tulsa freight sondra
then dont sign net-new KC bulk until 2027, or sign the kind with margin worth the nightly pallet tetris. healthcare + anything south/southwest routes fine out of tulsa today, 68% cube down there
:popcorn:

back to the portal - whatever the true adoption number is, the april analytics show portal orders come in bigger and cost a fraction to process vs rep-keyed. that delta is the pre-read i want quantified
bigger orders because bigger customers use it. selection effect. my best accounts would order big by carrier pigeon
possibly! lets cut the data both ways and see. same account before/after enrollment would settle it
adding the before/after cut to the pull list
also fair warning, the portal push lands badly in the field. hoss says his guys call it the pay cut portal
order goes through the portal, it gets coded house rate. reps arent stupid, they can read section 4.3 same as anyone
which makes it a comp plan design question, not a technology question. noted and agreed that we cant fix one without the other
its a paycheck question. treat it like one and the field will follow
fwiw at teh food show the accounts asking about portal access were our best street operators, not the laggards. the demand side of this is not the problem
ops seconds that. portal orders key cleaner, fewer mispicks, fewer redeliveries. every redelivery is the most expensive truck i run
ok. thursday 2pm, pre-reads to me by wednesday noon please. tyler that includes the actual enrollment number
:thumbsup: will have it
add the drop-size table to thursday too - 14% of street drops are under the $600 floor and that conversation is overdue
